title: Unique experience for wine and nature lovers
text:
100% recommended if you love nature and great cava! All of this in a very private setting, while enjoying stunning views from a Tesla 🤩

I live in Barcelona, and even I didn’t know about the places we visited. The views, the cava, meeting the winery owner, and learning directly from them made this a truly unique experience.

Pedro is a fantastic host. He makes sure you’re always comfortable, well-fed, and have plenty to drink, while sharing his knowledge as a local with roots across the Penedès wine region and the beautiful Canary Islands. There’s so much to learn from him and be inspired by.
author: U516UNjuancarlost

title: Premium, Private Wine Tour Near Barcelona Done Right
text:
We had a fantastic experience with Pedro and EVE BCN. From the start, it was clear he brings real hospitality expertise and focuses on creating a memorable day, not just running a standard tour.

The whole experience felt personal and unhurried. The drive through the vineyards was extremely comfortable, the scenery around Penedès and Montserrat was stunning, and the winery visit itself was excellent.

The food selection was spot on, and the cava was among the best we had during our stay in Barcelona. The fact that everything was fully private made a big difference, with no feeling of being rus
author: TimW864
